_comment: Pinterest daily drip queue (owner-approved 16 Oct 2026). config.pins_per_day is THE release rate. The feed (lib/pinfeed.ts) shows the 6 launch items plus every variant whose release_date <= today in America/Chicago, newest config.max_feed_items, filtered at request time on the Worker - no deploy per day. Written by scripts/pinterest/pin_queue.mjs (weekly: .github/workflows/pinterest-drip.yml); guarded by tests/unit/pinqueue.test.ts.

log.change: pins_per_day 1 -> 3, four topic boards, question pages pinned
log.why: 1 a day on one board gave 26 impressions, 0 clicks, 0 saves in 30 days (Pinterest analytics, 1 Nov 2026); Pinterest distributes fresh pins, a month of 1 a day showed too little reach to measure, and 3 a day stays far under the 200-a-day auto-publish cap. Stop rule unchanged from the Growth playbook: 0 clicks at 4 weeks -> new format, 8 weeks -> pause

log.change: guides-wedding-final-payment-checklist-01 released 1 Nov (one pin per board on the board-split day); products-checklist-pdf-07 fills its old slot
log.why: Pinterest refuses to connect an RSS feed with no items ('The RSS feed has no items'); each new topic board needs a pin on the day its feed is connected

log.change: brand pins with topic art: layouts tab-panel/header/card/binder-page/split, palettes ivory/blue-soft/coral-soft/midnight; fallback layouts header/split (headline-led); every unreleased pin replaced and gated (scripts/pinterest/quality.mjs)
log.why: 23 guide pages shared 4 checklist photos, so pins were near-duplicates and often off-topic, and some headlines were vague; her call 6 Nov 2026: "approve all, make them good"

variants.description: Decide what must travel in carry-on luggage for a destination wedding: rings, attire, documents and medication should not be left to checked bags.

variants.headline: Give the Day-of Coordinator a Vendor Sheet With Arrival Times
variants.title: Day-of Coordinator Checklist: A Vendor Sheet With Arrival Times
variants.description: For each supplier the day-of coordinator needs a name, a mobile number, an arrival time and a load-in location.

variants.headline: Plan Who Owns Each Task Before Anyone Assumes
variants.title: Wedding Planning Checklist PDF: Plan Who Owns Each Task
variants.description: A wedding planning checklist with a responsibility field on every row, so each task has a named owner instead of an assumption. 104-row editable checklist and 13-page printable PDF.

variants.headline: Compare Venues Side by Side in One Planning Bundle
variants.title: Wedding Planning Bundle: Compare Venues Side by Side Before You Book
variants.description: A venue comparison worksheet is included in the Dream Wedding Operations Suite, alongside the checklist, budget spreadsheet, timeline template and seating chart maker.

variants.headline: Cross Out What Doesn’t Apply on Your Printable List
variants.subline: Then write one owner per line
variants.title: Printable Wedding Checklist: Cross Out What Doesn’t Apply, Then Assign Owners
variants.description: How to use a printable wedding checklist: cross out the tasks that do not apply to your wedding, then write one owner on every line that is left.

lines: Then write one owner per line

variants.headline: Get the Location Permit Before You Book Elopement Flights
variants.title: Elopement Planning: Get the Location Permit Before Booking Flights
variants.description: Some elopement locations need a permit. Secure it before booking travel, then plan photos, attire and the day itself.

variants.headline: Bring the Right ID and Documents to the Courthouse
variants.title: Courthouse Wedding Checklist: Bring the Right ID and Documents
variants.description: Verify the identification and document requirements directly with your courthouse, gather them ahead of time and bring a printed confirmation.

variants.headline: Confirm Legal or Symbolic Before You Plan the Destination
variants.title: Destination Wedding: Confirm a Legal or Symbolic Ceremony First
variants.description: Confirm whether the destination ceremony will be legal or symbolic before building the rest of the plan around it.

variants.headline: Track Final Payments in Your Printable Checklist
variants.title: Wedding Checklist Printable: Track Final Payments in One Place
variants.description: The Wedding Checklist PDF keeps final payments on their own tracker, so vendor balances and due dates are not buried in the long-range plan. Includes a 13-page printable PDF.

variants.headline: Stop Juggling Four Templates: One Planning Bundle
variants.title: Wedding Planning Bundle: Stop Juggling Four Separate Templates
variants.description: One bundle instead of four separate templates: the Wedding Checklist PDF, Wedding Budget Spreadsheet, Wedding Timeline Template and Wedding Seating Chart Maker.

variants.headline: Book Venue and Key Vendors in Printable Checklist Order
variants.title: Printable Wedding Checklist: Book the Venue and Key Vendors in Order
variants.description: After the foundations, the printable checklist moves to venue and ceremony access, then catering, photography, entertainment and the other key vendors.

variants.headline: Eloping? Know the Waiting Period Before You Pick a Date
variants.title: Eloping? Know the Waiting Period Before You Pick a Date
variants.description: Waiting periods vary by place. Confirm the waiting period with the issuing office before setting the elopement date and booking travel.

variants.headline: Know the Courthouse Photo and Security Rules Before You Go
variants.title: Courthouse Wedding: Know the Photo and Security Rules Before You Go
variants.description: Courthouses set their own security screening and photography rules. Check what yours allows before the ceremony day.

variants.headline: Set Up Room Blocks and Transport for Destination Guests
variants.title: Destination Wedding Checklist: Room Blocks, Transport and Local Contacts
variants.description: The travel layer of a destination wedding: room blocks, guest transport and local contacts.

variants.headline: Hand Off Wedding Week With a Printable Tracker
variants.title: Wedding Checklist Printable: Hand Off Wedding Week With a Separate Tracker
variants.description: A separate wedding-week tracker keeps the handoff apart from long-range planning, so the people running the week get only what they need. Part of the 13-page printable Wedding Checklist PDF.

variants.headline: Hand Off Wedding Week With the Planning Bundle
variants.title: Wedding Planning Bundle: Hand Off Wedding Week With Contacts and Roles
variants.description: The Operations Suite includes a wedding-week handoff packet with emergency contacts and a responsibility matrix, so the people running the week know who does what.

variants.headline: Finish the Printable Checklist With Counts and Balances
variants.title: Printable Wedding Checklist: Finish With Final Counts, Balances and Receipts
variants.description: The last stage of the printable checklist: final guest, meal, allergy and accessibility inputs, seating and escort-card data, final balances, gratuities and receipts.

variants.headline: Elope Without Missing a Legal Step
variants.title: Elopement Planning Checklist: Elope Without Missing a Legal Step
variants.description: A free elopement planning checklist: marriage license requirements, any waiting period, witness rules, the officiant’s authority and location permits, checked before travel.

variants.headline: Plan Arrival, Parking and Witnesses for City Hall
variants.title: City Hall Wedding Checklist: Plan Arrival, Parking and Witnesses
variants.description: Assign your witnesses, plan arrival and parking, then decide what celebration or announcements follow the courthouse ceremony.

variants.headline: Check Shipping Rules Before Anything Ships to Your Destination
variants.title: Destination Wedding: Check Shipping Restrictions Before Anything Ships
variants.description: Shipping is its own dependency in destination planning. Check shipping restrictions before anything is sent.

variants.headline: See Vendor Dependencies Before They Block Your Planning
variants.subline: Dependency and status on every row
variants.title: Wedding Planning Checklist: See Vendor Dependencies Before They Block You
variants.description: Vendor and payment dependencies are surfaced on the checklist itself, with dependency, priority and status fields on all 104 rows, so you see what is waiting on what before it blocks the plan.

variants.headline: Get the Budget Spreadsheet and Seating Chart Maker Together
variants.title: Wedding Budget Planning: Plan the Budget and Seating Chart Together
variants.description: The Wedding Budget Spreadsheet and the Wedding Seating Chart Maker come together in the Dream Wedding Operations Suite, with the checklist and timeline template.

variants.headline: Print a Checklist That Ends With the Wedding-Week Handoff
variants.title: Printable Wedding Checklist: End With the Wedding-Week Handoff
variants.description: The printable checklist ends with the handoff: master and role-specific timelines, emergency contacts, legal documents, setup and the return plan.

variants.headline: Plan Photos and Attire After the Elopement Paperwork
variants.subline: Legal steps first, then the day
variants.title: Elopement Planning Checklist: Paperwork First, Then Photos and Attire
variants.description: Plan the legal side of an elopement first: license, waiting period, witnesses, officiant and permits. Then plan photos, attire and the day itself.

lines: Legal steps first, then the day

variants.headline: Keep a Courthouse Wedding Small Without Skipping Steps
variants.subline: A real checklist for a short ceremony
variants.title: Courthouse Wedding Checklist: Keep It Small Without Skipping Steps
variants.description: A small ceremony still has a checklist: appointment, license, witnesses, identification, security and photography rules, arrival and parking.

lines: A real checklist for a short ceremony

variants.headline: Plan a Weather Backup for Your Destination Wedding
variants.title: Destination Wedding Checklist: Plan a Weather Backup
variants.description: Weather contingencies are part of the destination plan, alongside travel, lodging, local vendors, documents and shipping.
